title: Sign in with demo credentials to access the dashboard
description: Verifies a user can log in with the demo credentials and is redirected to the protected dashboard where authenticated content is visible.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill test@example.com into the email field
Fill password123 into the password field
Submit the login form
Verify the user lands on the dashboard

title: Enforce dashboard protection when unauthenticated
description: Verifies direct access to the dashboard without an authenticated session redirects the user to the login page.

steps.description: Navigate to /dashboard
Verify the user lands on the login page

title: Log out to end the session and block dashboard access
description: Verifies an authenticated user can log out, returns to login, and can no longer access the dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill test@example.com into the email field
Fill password123 into the password field
Submit the login form
Trigger the logout action
Navigate to /dashboard
Verify the user lands on the login page

title: Submit a valid contact message successfully
description: Verifies a visitor can submit the contact form with valid inputs and sees the success confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to /contact
Fill Jane Doe into the name field
Fill jane.doe@example.com into the email field
Fill I would like more information into the message field
Submit the contact form
Verify the exact text "Message sent!" is visible

title: Navigate across primary pages via the navbar
description: Verifies a visitor can use the top navigation to reach About, Contact, and Login pages and each page renders its expected content.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the link to view the about page
Click the link to view the contact page
Click the link to view the login page
Verify the login form is displayed

title: Block contact submission when required fields are missing
description: Verifies the contact form prevents submission with missing required input and shows the validation error message.

steps.description: Navigate to /contact
Fill Jane Doe into the name field
Fill jane.doe@example.com into the email field
Fill  into the message field
Submit the contact form
Verify the exact text "Fill all fields correctly." is visible

title: Display authenticated dashboard welcome state after login
description: Verifies the dashboard shows the expected authenticated welcome message after a successful login.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill test@example.com into the email field
Fill password123 into the password field
Submit the login form
Verify the exact text "Welcome! You are logged in." is visible

title: Home page renders the demo introduction and feature list
description: Verifies the home page loads and shows the demo heading and a list of key features.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify the home page heading is displayed
Verify a feature list is displayed

title: View About page content
description: Verifies a visitor can open the About page and see the About heading and the feature list rendered.

steps.description: Navigate to /about
Verify the About page heading is displayed
Verify a list describing the demo features is displayed

title: API hello endpoint returns the expected JSON message
description: Verifies that visiting the hello API route returns a JSON response containing the expected hello message.

steps.description: Navigate to /api/hello
Verify the response body contains the exact text "Hello from TestSprite API!"

title: Navigate to About from Home
description: Verifies a visitor can use the primary navigation to go from Home to About and the About content renders.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the navigation link to the About page
Verify the About page heading is displayed
Verify a list describing the demo features is displayed

title: Reject invalid credentials and show the exact guidance message
description: Verifies entering wrong credentials keeps the user on the login page and displays the exact error guidance text.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill wrong@example.com into the email field
Fill wrongpass into the password field
Submit the login form
Verify the exact text "Use test@example.com / password123" is visible

title: Return to Home from custom 404 page
description: Verifies the custom 404 page is shown for an invalid route and the user can return to Home using the Go Home link.

steps.description: Navigate to /_not-found
Verify the 404 page heading is displayed
Click the link to go home
Verify the user lands on the home page

title: Custom 404 page shows explanatory subtitle
description: Verifies the custom 404 page displays an explanatory subtitle indicating the page does not exist.

steps.description: Navigate to /_not-found
Verify the 404 page heading is displayed
Verify an explanatory subtitle indicating the page does not exist is displayed
